  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDraw2D
from rdkit.Chem import rdDepictor
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import sys

# atom list: (element, x, y) in image coords (y down). z=0.
atoms = [
 ('C',147,256), #0 MeL
 ('C',218,262), #1 A4 quaternary (2 Me)
 ('C',162,158), #2 A3 alkene CH
 ('C',283,130), #3 A2 alkene CH
 ('C',390,160), #4 A1 carbonyl C (enone)
 ('C',339,240), #5 A5 ring junction
 ('C',452,262), #6 A6/P bridgehead
 ('C',218,362), #7 MeD
 ('O',470, 70), #8 O enone
 ('C',577,262), #9 Q bridgehead
 ('C',605,150), #10 CR cyclopentanone carbonyl C
 ('O',549, 30), #11 O cyclopentanone
 ('C',722,146), #12 CqR ring junction (dashed Me)
 ('C',800, 90), #13 MeR dashed
 ('C',680,267), #14 BR right lower junction
 ('C',613,348), #15 CM lower bold CH
 ('C',830,328), #16 EXO =CH2 terminal
 ('C',492,347), #17 R lower bridgehead
 ('O',377,327), #18 Omid ether
 ('C',365,435), #19 HX
 ('O',337,465), #20 Olac lactone ring O
 ('C',455,465), #21 Clow lactone carbonyl C
 ('O',527,570), #22 Olow =O
 ('C',700,300), #23 EXOattach? ring carbon bearing =CH2 (candidate)
]
# bonds: (i,j,order) order 1 single 2 double; optional stereo 'u' up (toward),'d' down
bonds = [
 (4,8,2),
 (4,3,1),(3,2,2),(2,1,1),(1,5,1),(5,6,1),(6,4,1),
 (1,0,1),(1,7,1),
 (6,9,1),
 (9,10,1),(10,11,2),(10,12,1),
 (12,13,1),
 (12,14,1),
 (14,23,1),(23,16,2),   # BR - C(=CH2) ; exocyclic methylene
 (14,15,1),(15,17,1),   # bold lower edge BR-CM-R
 (17,21,1),(21,22,2),(21,20,1),  # R - C(=O) - Olac
 (20,19,1),             # Olac - HX
 (18,19,1),             # Omid - HX ? (tentative)
 (17,9,1),              # R - Q (close central) tentative
]
# We'll iterate. Build mol.
def build(bonds):
    m=Chem.RWMol()
    for el,x,y in atoms:
        a=Chem.Atom(el); m.AddAtom(a)
    for i,j,o in bonds:
        bt = Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if o==2 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE
        m.AddBond(i,j,bt)
    return m

m=build(bonds)
conf=Chem.Conformer(len(atoms))
for k,(el,x,y) in enumerate(atoms):
    conf.SetAtomPosition(k, Point3D(x*0.02, -y*0.02, 0.0))  # scale to ~angstrom, flip y for depiction
m.AddConformer(conf)
try:
    m2=m.GetMol()
    Chem.SanitizeMol(m2)
    print('SANITIZE OK')
    print('heavy atoms', m2.GetNumAtoms())
    print('formula', Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m2))
except Exception as e:
    print('SANITIZE FAIL:', e)
# report valence
m3=m.GetMol()
try:
    m3.UpdatePropertyCache(strict=False)
    for a in m3.GetAtoms():
        if a.GetAtomicNum()==6:
            print('C',a.GetIdx(),'deg',a.GetDegree(),'val',a.GetExplicitValence(),'impH',a.GetNumImplicitHs())
except Exception as e:
    print('vcache',e)
# render with our coords + atom indices
try:
    d=rdMolDraw2D.MolDraw2DCairo(900,650)
    d.drawOptions().addAtomIndices=True
    d.DrawMolecule(m.GetMol())
    d.FinishDrawing()
    open('cand.png','wb').write(d.GetDrawingText())
    print('wrote cand.png')
except Exception as e:
    print('draw fail',e)

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Chem.Draw import rdMolDraw2D
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
from rdkit import Chem as _C

atoms = [
 ('C',147,256),('C',218,262),('C',162,158),('C',283,130),('C',390,160),('C',339,240),('C',452,262),('C',218,362),
 ('O',470, 70),('C',577,262),('C',605,150),('O',549, 30),('C',722,146),('C',800, 90),('C',680,267),('C',613,348),
 ('C',830,328),('C',492,347),('O',377,327),('C',365,435),('O',337,465),('C',455,465),('O',527,570),('C',700,300),('C',540,205),
]
bonds = [
 (4,8,2),(4,3,1),(3,2,2),(2,1,1),(1,5,1),(5,6,1),(6,4,1),(1,0,1),(1,7,1),
 (9,24,1),(24,10,1),(10,11,2),(10,12,1),(12,13,1),(12,14,1),(14,9,1),
 (6,9,1),(14,23,1),(23,16,2),(23,15,1),(15,17,1),(17,6,1),
 (5,18,1),(18,19,1),(19,20,1),(20,21,1),(21,22,2),(21,17,1),
]
m=Chem.RWMol()
for el,x,y in atoms: m.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el))
for i,j,o in bonds:
    m.AddBond(i,j, Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if o==2 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
mol=m.GetMol()
conf=Chem.Conformer(len(atoms))
for k,(el,x,y) in enumerate(atoms):
    conf.SetAtomPosition(k, Point3D(float(x), float(-y), 0.0))
mol.AddConformer(conf)
# stereo bond: dashed Me on C12 (behind). Also bold front edges as wedges (up).
def bdir(i,j,d):
    b=mol.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j); b.SetBondDir(d)
# dashed Me: narrow at 12, going away
bdir(12,13, Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
# bold (toward) edges: choose narrow end at the bridgehead (front). Use BEGINWEDGE.
for (i,j) in [(6,9),(9,14),(12,14),(14,23),(23,15),(15,17),(17,6),(5,6),(6,4)]:
    bdir(i,j, Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
# write V2000 mol block and read back to perceive chirality from wedges
mb=Chem.MolToMolBlock(mol, forceV3000=False)
mol2=Chem.MolFromMolBlock(mb, sanitize=True, removeHs=False)
print('chiral centers:', Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol2, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol2, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('after assign:', Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol2, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
# embed honoring chirality
mh=Chem.AddHs(mol2)
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=1234; p.useRandomCoords=True; p.enforceChirality=True; p.numThreads=0
best=None
for seed in [1,7,42,1234,2024,555,8888,31337]:
    p.randomSeed=seed
    cid=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,p)
    if cid==0:
        try:
            e=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, mmffVariant='MMFF94s', maxIters=1500)
            props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mh, mmffVariant='MMFF94s')
            ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mh, props)
            en=ff.CalcEnergy()
        except Exception:
            AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=1500); en=1e9
        if best is None or en<best[0]:
            best=(en,seed,Chem.Mol(mh))
print('best', best[1], 'E', best[0])
mh=best[2]
# final polish MMFF
try:
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, mmffVariant='MMFF94s', maxIters=3000)
except Exception: pass
Chem.MolToXYZFile(mh,'answer.xyz')
# depict 2D with stereo annotations for check
m3=Chem.RemoveHs(mh)
rd=Chem.rdDepictor.Compute2DCoords(m3)
d=rdMolDraw2D.MolDraw2DCairo(900,650); d.DrawMolecule(m3); d.FinishDrawing(); open('stereo2d.png','wb').write(d.GetDrawingText())
print('atoms in answer:', mh.GetNumAtoms(), 'formula', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mh))
print('wrote answer.xyz, stereo2d.png')
